text.p: A total of 1.29 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom changed hands in electronic trading on Friday at an average 2,749 roubles ($0.487) a share, down from 2,757 roubles at the previous session on Wednesday, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
Full details of the trading session:
Gazprom is one of Russia's biggest companies by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid because of company restrictions on selling them.
The company has organised regular auctions and electronic trading sessions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom was $0.485 at 0943 GMT on Friday on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.490 on Thursday.
Its American Depositary Shares were $19.725 after $19.475. One ADS is equivalent to 10 ordinary shares.
The next electronic trading sessions will be held on February 12, 14, 19 and 21.
